(check), 𘍡=7, 𘑁=8. 𘗊…𗭋 brackets expressions, 𘑰 begins arguments, 𘑐 argument separator, 𘄗 clause terminator. Need distinguish 𘌿/𗈇/𘑌 prefixes, likely semantic categories not simple yes/no.

We have overconcentration grammar. Power-stage clue labels appear agent-local/nonce: 𗮆𘋷 cannot be globally BOOT (a2 uses it for base WAVE at [9], a5 for DRAIN at [35], a1 for CRANK [39], a0 for BOOT [38], a4 SIGNAL [33]). Important focus shift: 𗼾 agent_N TERM clearly resolves speaker-local defined handles, not ordinary possessives alone. All symbol owners use 𗢋𗠉 (a local handle) except agents 2/7 use 𗮆𘋷; refs align a0=MOON, a4/a3=SUN, a6/a1=STAR, a2/a7=WAVE. Power reuses same handles with different referents by stage, so don't globally map 𗢋𗠉 to a symbol. I'll focus local handle definitions and grammar rather than duplicate early-message work.

Numbers high-confidence from independent clues: 𗋕=0; 𗵺=1; 𘋃=2; 𗮥=3; 𘛦=4; 𘍡=7; 𘑁=8; 𗻫=9 (exit first/third computations); 𗫆=6 (SUN exit). Likely 𗂮=5 (STAR descriptions mention five points; msg67 invalid count=5?); 𘞝 unknown numeral. I suspect 𗢋𗠉 and 𗮆𘋷 are agent-local label A/B, NOT globally stable objects: multiple agents describe different symbol/control using same label, necessitating 𗼾 agent_N label references. Will investigate.

Please send translations grouped by message number, retaining uncertainties and actual wording rather than normalizing to supplied solution. I will instead focus on translation of exit messages 85–101, since many agents already cover grammar. Preliminary robust: exit position reports are 89/90/91/94, offsets 85/86/87/88; numerical final values need distinguish base vs derived. Will report detailed decoding.

Exit-stage analysis: numeric 𗛱 𗋕 after 𗮥 (msg85), 𘍡 (85), 𘋃 (96), and action phrase (48) plausibly represents decimal '.0', not additional semantics; 𗋕 independently appears battery 0 in msg67. Thus 85 likely offset(star,3.0), value(star,7.0); 96 offset(moon,2.0). Exit final digits evident 𗻫=9, 𗫆=6, 𘍡=7. I will focus detailed exit 85–101 and confidence cautions.

Compiling full document once translation chunks arrive. Power translation progressing; caveat numeric disagreement: msgs36/43 report same battery/status expression =𘛦(4), 56=𘋃(2), 67=𗂮, 81=𘋃(2). This strongly favors 𗂮=5 and 𗋕=0 (consistent [39] CRANK upfront cost zero), NOT reverse. Actual BOOT success may occur just before 78 while agent3's 81 reading was generated before it. Correction to my previous numeral note: I retract my 𗋕=5 / 𗂮=0 suggestion; other agents' 𗋕=0 and 𗂮=5 fit the repeated decimal '.0' and STAR five-point description much better. Early translations confidently recover relations, but lexical shape descriptions remain opaque: [2] defines a6's A as STAR (description partly unknown), equates digit-of-A to 4; [3] defines a0's A as MOON (description partly unknown), value A=7; [4] defines a4's A as SUN, digit/value-of-A=2; [5] defines a5's A as MOON via shape-description; [6] defines a3's A as SUN, position1 in cabinet contains symbol A. I will send exact remaining early relational translations shortly.

Numeral correction/audit: I maintain 𗋕=0 and 𗂮=5 (NOT opposite). Strong battery evidence: a3 msg36/43 reports value4, msg56 value2 (after DRAIN), msg67 value𗂮=5 (after CRANK), msg81 value2 (after SIGNAL, likely stale relative BOOT). Subject '𗶩 𗍵𘄣 𗔸 [𘕼 𗋕]' likely result/output of API/code0, NOT battery5. Also star description msg2 can naturally mention five tips 𗂮. Thus all decimal digits: 0𗋕 1𗵺 2𘋃 3𗮥 4𘛦 5𗂮 6𗫆 7𘍡 8𘑁 9𗻫. 𘞝 remains unknown, not numeral6.

Prefix/number caution: 𗛱 𗋕 repeatedly follows exit offset/final values [85,88,96] and DRAIN action [48], so do not automatically read as '+0' or digit syntax; likely contextual modifier ('now' / 'positive' / 'new', unknown). 𗋕 inside battery noun phrase [36/43/etc] also need not be digit. Agent-local alias scope is strongly established; grammatical reconstruction should explicitly avoid assigning each opaque alias a global meaning. Investigating prefix semantics next.

High-confidence LOCAL ALIASES (not global glyph meanings): cabinet agent0 𗢋𗠉=MOON; a1 𗢋𗠉=STAR; a2 𗮆𘋷=WAVE; a3/a4 𗢋𗠉=SUN; a5 𗢋𗠉=MOON; a6 𗢋𗠉=STAR; a7 𗮆𘋷=WAVE. Exit translations (high-level, local aliases retained): 79 DRAIN/SIGNAL? exact first: completed(a2 SIGNAL); then a7 [future/attempt] act(a0 BOOT). 81 current battery reading=2; a3 attempts BOOT. 83 reports result of a1 action(a2 SIGNAL), then a1 attempts BOOT. 85 offset(a6 STAR)=3.0; value(a6 STAR)=7.0. 89 exit position2 displays a6 STAR; asks all for [exit code/order]. 90 exit position4 displays a3 SUN; asks all [exit code/order]. 91 exit position1 displays a2 WAVE. 94 exit position3 displays a0 MOON; asks value of that MOON at exit. 95 position2 value7; asks what position3 displays. 96 MOON offset2.0; value9 at exit; asks what position3 displays. 97 position1 value9; asks what position3 displays. 99 value(a2 WAVE)=7 at exit (!! actual mistaken claim, do not normalize to 9); asks someone to do/submit exit code. 101 position3 value9; a6 attempts [battery? cabinet? code object] at exit. Digits 𗋕=0 and 𗂮=5 fit battery trace (msg67 battery after CRANK=5). 𗛱 𗋕 likely decimal '.0', but mark medium/low rather than certain. I'll refine exit 86–88,92–98 and send.

Compiler ready; please send numbered translation chunks now even partial. I will assemble initial document immediately with high-confidence grammar/local aliases/numbers plus all messages. Keep uncertain predicates as literal relation gloss rather than force task wording; key to avoid interpreting every successful/rejected action from adjacent status alone.

Lexicon high confidence beyond aliases/numerals: 𗼾 agent_N TERM = explicit reference into agent_N's naming scope; 𗲣 = same/equivalent; 𘂽 = value (numeric value or evaluation in context); 𗂤 = change/offset or increase (exit 85/96, CRANK 39), 𗅪 = cost/consumption; 𗥔 = requires/precondition relation; 𗉶 = completed/done; 𗇬 = indexed position; 𗏎 = contains/displays; 𘕼 likely numbered 'code' object rather than battery: [23] attempts [𘕼 1], [48] DRAIN 0 modifier .0 suggests number syntax but not certain. 𘛗 possibly error/rejection response. Shape-description roots should stay explicitly opaque rather than invented. I will independently audit decimal/number formatting and send.

Ready to compile; waiting numbered translation chunks from assigned agents. Please prioritize sending your current partial translations over further analysis. I will integrate and explicitly flag uncertain grammar/predicates, numerals and action timing. Need grammar-prefix best hypotheses from decoder_4/5 too.

Correction to my last numeral note: 𗋕=0 remains plausible/high confidence, not retracted; 𗂮=5 strong. Independent power chronology audit: a3 reports charge4 in36/43, charge2 in56, charge5 in67, charge2 in81 (stale relative BOOT possible). Thus DRAIN succeeded between43–56, CRANK between56–67, SIGNAL between67–81, BOOT before78. Do not assign particular success to immediately adjacent messages: multiple concurrent attempts. Relations in46 likely precedes(DRAIN,CRANK), distinct(a7 CRANK,a2 SIGNAL), precedes(a2 SIGNAL,BOOT); 50 uses 𗴢 = same/equal to unify a1 CRANK=a5 DRAIN? Wait this last equality is clearly FALSE, so prefix/operator epistemic polarity must be retained rather than flattening statements. Msg50 actually juxtaposes aliases a1 CRANK and a5 DRAIN with same predicate repeated; possible 𗴢 means 'different' not equality. I will resolve that lexical relation next.

Additional exit chunk, keeping uncertain predicates explicit: [86] value(new-offset-of own SUN)=4; value(SUN)=6 at exit; asks offset of [MOON?/crescent-like object at exit] (last object medium/low). [87] value(own MOON)=9 in/for [offset-related compound]; asks offset of [exit MOON-related compound], exact noun unknown. [88] completed(a0 BOOT); value(own WAVE)=9 [of compound containing offset], with modifier 𗛱 𗋕; asks offset of [SUN?/object at exit], low confidence noun. [92] two questions with predicate 𗦎 about a0 MOON and a2 WAVE, each '? at exit'; likely requesting their digits/codes, not necessarily offsets. [93] value(exit position2)=7; value(exit position4)=6; two requests/permissions to perform/do something involving exit stage/code (one uses unknown 𘞝, second numeral3). [98] value([𘐅 4 at exit])=6, likely position4 with variant/typo position noun; then requests someone perform/submit exit-stage code. Please do not overtranslate 𗛱𗋕 as decimal .0; remains plausible but weak versus modifier. Prefix/action predicates uncertain enough to render 'reports/attempts' rather than verified success.

Prefix semantics remain unresolved; please resist labeling 𗈇 simply negation. It occurs in initial SUN/MOON/WAVE definitions and in a7 [53] relation between a7 CRANK and a1 CRANK (which task evidence says should be same); could indicate lower confidence, hypothesized assertion, or a semantic type. 𘌿 dominates explicit supplied clue values and successful-result reports; 𗈇 dominates many unknown/question and failure reports; ☑ markers also appear before attempts. Confidence/mood/polarity interpretation only medium/low until exact convention found.

Additional lexical caution: 𗛱 𗋕 may be decimal '.0' (consistent 3.0/7.0/2.0/9.0) but DRAIN 𗛱 𗋕 in [48] is hard to explain, so I recommend LOW confidence for decimal syntax, high for 𗋕=0 based CRANK no-cost [39] and repeated numbered code-object [𘕼 𗋕] = code0. Do NOT globally translate 𘕼 as battery; [23] act(agent3,[𘕼 1]) is cabinet-code submission, whereas [36] value([𗶩 𗍵𘄣 of [𘕼 0]])=4 plausibly API-result battery field. 𘞝 remains unknown; appears only [93] where they request do(code UNKNOWN of exit), followed do(code3 of exit), possibly category 'whole/all' rather than digit.

Power root/action mapping (high/medium): 𗅪=cost, 𗂤=increment/addition (CRANK gain3, exit offsets), 𗥔=requires/prerequisite, 𗉶=completed/done, 𗵉=try/attempt, 𘋶=execute/use (near-synonym uncertain), 𗶩=result/success. 𘋷 marks future/intention in action clauses; 𗅰 requests; 𗓿=report/tell; 𗿖=everyone. Battery expression repeated by a3 [36/43/56/67/81] values 4,4,2,5,2. Will send numbered translations in next chunk. Confidence caution: cannot yet translate leading 𘌿/𗈇/𘑌; do NOT equate 𗈇 with negation indiscriminately.

I now have early/exit numbered chunks and will write complete draft next turn. decoder_3 PLEASE SEND power numbered chunk immediately (23–77), even partial; decoder_4 please send best prefix/question/action grammar now. Remaining uncertainty will be labeled, not normalized. I will preserve erroneous WAVE=7 in99 and distinguish reports/intent from verified outcomes.

Relation audit: [50] 𗴢 links three known DIFFERENT pairs: a1 CRANK/a5 DRAIN, a2 DRAIN/a1 CRANK, a6 BOOT/a2 DRAIN. Therefore 𗴢 likely 'different/distinct', not equality (high-medium). [46] 𗷿 links DRAIN→CRANK and SIGNAL→BOOT, strongly 'before/precedes' (high); 𘗒 links a7 CRANK/a2 SIGNAL with different prefix 𗈇, plausibly identity negated, but prefix semantics unresolved. [53] a7 uses 𗈇 with 𗲣 for CRANK versus a1 CRANK; that apparent equal-reference contradiction means do not force 𗈇=negation without caveat.

Exit final-object refinement: 𘕼 is probably 'code' (medium), NOT battery. It occurs as action target [23] 'code 1', [25]/[35] 'code ... cabinet', and [101] 'code 𘂭 ... exit'. So [101] best 'a6 attempts/submits the [unknown modifier 𘂭] exit code'; task subsequently confirms escape. 𘂭 also modifies exit noun [94], perhaps 'new/current/controller', unknown. Keep [99] literal mistaken WAVE=7 at exit; do not normalize to 9. My full exit chunks are above, available for compilation.

Early lexical hypotheses to mark LOW only (not full translations): 𗽬 likely cabinet, 𗱺 likely exit, 𗡭 likely code (e.g [8] position3 vs later stage/code requests). SUN descriptive compound 𗃪 𗙐 𗃾 in [6] plausibly 'sky light source'; MOON compound 𗢋 𗃾 𗣮 in [3] plausibly 'night sky circle'. These are recurrence/task-based guesses, not secure dictionary mappings. Prefixes cannot safely be plain true/false/unknown because 𗈇 repeatedly introduces valid SUN/MOON descriptions; leave unidentified mood/category unless further evidence. Earlier numbered chunk remains my recommended cautious translation.

Lexicon final recommendations for compiler: all ten digit mappings are defensible (0𗋕,1𗵺,2𘋃,3𗮥,4𘛦,5𗂮,6𗫆,7𘍡,8𘑁,9𗻫); qualify inference sources, especially 0 from no-upfront-cost CRANK and 5 from battery reading/STAR description. Keep 𗛱𗋕 unresolved (possible '.0', LOW), 𘞝 unknown. Strong relational roots: 𗲣 equivalence, 𘂽 numeric value, 𗂤 change/increment/offset, 𗅪 cost, 𗥔 prerequisite, 𗉶 completion, 𗇬 indexed position, 𗏎 contents/display. 𘕼 should remain 'code/action-related object', not globally battery; a3's battery readings use a nested expression involving it. Alias/coreference reconstruction is our strongest non-task-supplied decoding evidence.

Grammar best current reconstruction: clause = PREFIX [modal] 𘍢 PREDICATE 𘑰 ARG1 (𘑐 ARG2...) 𘄗; nested nominal/compound = 𘗊 HEAD modifiers/args 𗭋; 𗔸 appears genitive/contextual 'of/in', 𗴍 another relation/linker (uncertain). 𗼾 agent_N HANDLE explicitly resolves that agent's local handle, indispensable because A/B labels differ by sender and stage. 𗪣 likely interrogative marker (co-occurs unknown placeholder 𘆖 in virtually every question); 𗅰 request/directive; 𘋷 intention/future; 𘎴 relational/inference mode unknown. Prefixes 𘌿 / 𗈇 / 𘑌 remain LOW-confidence: possible epistemic certainty/polarity or assertion types; do not translate as simple positive/negative. 𗈇 appears both initial shape-definitions and failure/result clauses, but a7 [53] uses it for equivalence CRANK=a1 CRANK, so ordinary negation would contradict intended task relation. I recommend preserving prefix distinctions as opaque rather than asserting exact truth semantics.

Prefix audit: no firm mapping for 𘌿/𗈇/𘑌. A tentative true/false/unknown or assertion/negation/uncertainty scheme fits some action-result clauses (58 versus 62/75/77), but conflicts with other clauses unless agents made errors or 𗶩 is merely 'result' rather than 'success'. Recommend explicitly unknown clause-class/polarity markers, NOT fluent translations that silently erase them. Other grammar high confidence: 𘍢 introduces predicate, 𘑰 argument list, 𘑐 separates arguments, 𘄗 ends clause; 𘗊…𗭋 encloses compound noun/reference; nested clauses can themselves be arguments. 𗪣 is question/unknown-slot modifier (medium-high), 𗅰 request/directive (medium), 𘋷 prospective/intention (medium), 𘎴 relation-class marker (low-medium), 𗼫 agent_N adds speaker/actor restriction ('by agent_N', medium).

Final caution for compilation: suffix 𗛱 𗋕 occurs after DRAIN action [48] as well as numbers [85/88/96], so decimal '.0' is not secure. Best translate as '[unknown modifier involving 0]' rather than fluent decimal values, and record decimal vs temporal/current-time interpretation as LOW alternatives. Exit [101] target is code-object with unknown modifier 𘂭, not battery. All exit numbered translations already sent; ready to audit draft.

One caution for final: prefix-opaque claims should be glossed 'value(WAVE)=7 [prefix 𘌿]' rather than calling them certainly assertions if prefix semantics unknown.
